Best Ahri Runes

Using statistical analysis, we've calculated the highest win rate Ahri runes within this rune set, Primary Tree: Domination (Keystone: Electrocute) and Secondary Tree: Sorcery. For most situations, we recommend choosing the runes with the highest win count. The Primary (Domination) Runes with the most wins are Taste of Blood, Grisly Mementos, and Ultimate Hunter. The Secondary (Sorcery) Runes with the most wins are Manaflow Band, Transcendence, and Scorch.
